metadata.description: Community components, layouts, instruments and spaces for the Dimension platform. Slots are open and layout-owned; well-known names are published conventions (doc 68 §4.1).

plugins.name: agents-best-practices
plugins.title: Agents Best Practices
plugins.description: Agents Best Practices — provider-neutral agent-harness architecture: loops, tools, permissions, planning, memory, compaction, evals, safety

plugins.name: artifactory-general-agent
plugins.title: The Forge
plugins.description: The Forge — build a General Agent by hand or by talking to your agent: a three.js orrery where skills, MCP servers, memory and lineage orbit the agent's core, and the agent.md is written live beside it.

plugins.name: artifactory-system-monitor
plugins.title: System Monitor
plugins.description: System Monitor as an MCP App — the reference server from modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps, unmodified. A model-facing tool plus an app-only tool the View polls through the consent gate: the second Phase 4 pilot.

plugins.name: artifactory-threejs
plugins.title: Three.js
plugins.description: Three.js scenes as an MCP App — the reference server from modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps, unmodified, hosted by the Dimension engine and rendered in the artifact-view seat. The Phase 4 pilot: zero code of its own, just packaging.

plugins.name: ban-comments
plugins.title: Ban Comments
plugins.description: Ban Comments — a stream rule that stops the agent mid-edit when it writes a code comment and has it carry the meaning in names, types and structure instead

plugins.name: brand-marks
plugins.title: Brand Marks
plugins.description: Brand Marks — four presence avatars (X, Reddit, YouTube, Discord) for the avatar slot: the official mark, unmodified at rest, with container-only motion that follows the session.

plugins.name: browser
plugins.title: Browser
plugins.description: A real browser beside your chat that your agent drives while you watch. Tabs, persistent logged-in profiles, circle-to-annotate, and fast task agents (jev, browser-use).

plugins.name: build
plugins.title: Build
plugins.description: Build - the assembled workspace. The Code space rebuilt entirely from marketplace packs: rail, thread, composer, start surface, dock, environment and switcher are all replaceable parts. Install it beside Code and swap any one of them without touching the app.

spaces.label: Build
spaces.tagline: Every part of this workspace is a pack you can swap.

plugins.name: classic-dock
plugins.title: Classic Dock
plugins.description: The shipped dock COLUMN as a pack — tab strip, resize handle, panel body. Fills the `dock-column` contract (a `dock` component is an instrument, i.e. one tab).

plugins.name: classic-environment
plugins.title: Classic Environment
plugins.description: The shipped environment card, installable: re-exports ENVIRONMENT_CLASSIC from @fraym/ui - live SCM scan, submodule pins, worktree verbs, Push.

plugins.name: classic-rail
plugins.title: Classic Rail
plugins.description: The shipped session rail, installable: re-exports RAIL_CLASSIC from @fraym/ui - project grouping, rail actions, search, the full row model.

plugins.name: classic-start
plugins.title: Classic Start
plugins.description: The shipped START SURFACE as a pack — the session surface's front door: hero composer, Project · Work strip, popover menus. Fills the `start` contract (a SECTION like `thread`/`composer`, resolved inside the session surface). The hero sentence comes from the space's `workspace.startCopy`, never from the kit.

plugins.name: classic-switcher
plugins.title: Classic Switcher
plugins.description: The shipped switcher rail as a pack — the far-left column of space marks.

plugins.name: classic-workspace
plugins.title: Classic Workspace Host
plugins.description: The shipped workspace host as a pack — the center pane's splits, tiling and overlays. The first marketplace part to ever fill the `workspace` contract.

plugins.name: discord
plugins.title: Discord
plugins.description: Discord connector — list servers/channels, read and send messages via a bot token

plugins.name: example-agents
plugins.title: Example Agents
plugins.description: Example Agents - the reference pack for contributing a General Agent: one space, Example Hub, scoped to one sample marketing lead that ships off by default.

spaces.label: Example Hub
spaces.tagline: A reference space for contributors: the Build workspace, scoped to one General Agent — the Example Hub's marketing lead.

generalAgents.name: example-cmo
generalAgents.description: A sample marketing lead for the Example Hub — ships off by default; enable it in Capabilities → General Agents

plugins.name: github
plugins.title: GitHub
plugins.description: GitHub connector — issues, PRs, releases, repos, and search via the gh CLI

plugins.name: gmail
plugins.title: Gmail
plugins.description: Email connector — read/search/compose/reply over IMAP/SMTP via himalaya

plugins.name: google-calendar
plugins.title: Google Calendar
plugins.description: Manage Google Calendar events and schedules

plugins.name: google-drive
plugins.title: Google Drive
plugins.description: Google Drive connector — list/search/read files via OAuth

plugins.name: google-meet
plugins.title: Google Meet
plugins.description: Create Google Meet spaces, read conference records/recordings/transcripts, and live-transcribe a call

plugins.name: google-workspace
plugins.title: Google Workspace
plugins.description: Google Workspace connector — read/write Sheets, Docs, and Slides via OAuth

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.title: Impeccable
plugins.description: Impeccable — design guidance for AI agents: 23 design commands (craft, polish, audit, critique, bolder, quieter, distill…), anti-slop rules, and a deterministic anti-pattern detector

plugins.name: independent-composer
plugins.title: Independent Composer
plugins.description: A composer built independently on the bricks tier — Fraym primitives + tokens + the store channels. Ships no shipped-implementation import.

plugins.name: independent-rail
plugins.title: Independent Rail
plugins.description: Independent session rail assembled from the published PARTS (SessionRail, the rail chrome, and the three assembly hooks) - imports no shipped rail implementation. Speaks the rail slot's specVersion 2 channel contract.

plugins.name: independent-thread
plugins.title: Independent Thread
plugins.description: Independent thread section assembled from the published PARTS (Thread, SectionSessionScope, PresenceSurface, OpeningThreadSkeleton) — no shipped implementation imported.

plugins.name: last30days
plugins.title: last30days
plugins.description: last30days — research what people actually said about any topic in the last 30 days across Reddit, X, YouTube, TikTok, Hacker News, and the web

plugins.name: mochi-mark
plugins.title: Mochi Mark
plugins.description: A mark component drawn in a declared slot of a plugin layout — the import-surface FLOOR: react only, zero @fraym/ui.

plugins.name: phone
plugins.title: Phone
plugins.description: Phone - the Code session surface laid out for a 360-430px phone. The same shared components as Code (Assembled), bound to a layout with no switcher column (phone-switcher mounts in the rail drawer's head). The space Inso Mobile lands in; on a desktop, the honest preview of what a phone sees.

spaces.label: Phone
spaces.tagline: Your sessions, tool cards and approvals on a phone — the same components, laid out for one hand.

plugins.name: phone-switcher
plugins.title: Phone Switcher
plugins.description: The space switcher as a rail-head menu: re-exports SWITCHER_DROPDOWN from @fraym/ui. For layouts that cannot afford a 56px switcher column — the `phone` layout.

plugins.name: pr-viewer
plugins.title: PR Viewer
plugins.description: PR Viewer — reviews in the dock, from the Store's review keys. Installable and removable like any pack: with it a rail chip opens the review here, without it the browser.

plugins.name: product-psychology
plugins.title: Product Psychology
plugins.description: Product Psychology — audit conversion & comprehension, map remembered journeys, research users, and ethics-gate persuasion

plugins.name: pulse-mark
plugins.title: Pulse Mark
plugins.description: The Store's demo component: a mark with zero Fraym UI reading `sessions/list` through the one granted binding, selector-gated to a single boolean — the zero-import tier demonstrated.

plugins.name: reddit
plugins.title: Reddit
plugins.description: Reddit connector — feeds, posts, comments, search, submit, vote, and inbox via the Reddit OAuth API

plugins.name: router-jev
plugins.title: Jev room router
plugins.description: Room router backed by TypeSafe's Jev: when a room post addresses nobody, one System One request decides which agent leads the reply and who else should chime in

plugins.name: slack
plugins.title: Slack
plugins.description: Slack connector — list channels, read messages, and post via the Slack Web API

plugins.name: taste
plugins.title: Taste
plugins.description: Taste — anti-slop frontend skill: brief-first design reads, real design systems, no templated AI aesthetics

plugins.name: teams
plugins.title: Microsoft Teams
plugins.description: Microsoft Teams connector — list teams/channels and post channel messages via Microsoft Graph

plugins.name: telegram
plugins.title: Telegram
plugins.description: Telegram connector — send messages, read updates, inspect chats via the Bot API

plugins.name: triage-rail
plugins.title: Triage Rail
plugins.description: A session rail for threads, not folders: a violet Needs-you strip (oldest wait first), Now / Today / Yesterday / This week / Earlier groups, unread rows emphasised, and one Sweep that archives idle sessions older than a week. Built from @fraym/ui primitives and the rail slot's specVersion 2 channels only - no shipped rail inside.

plugins.name: ui-skills
plugins.title: UI Skills
plugins.description: UI Skills — opinionated interface-polish skills: baseline UI discipline, accessibility fixes, metadata audits, motion performance

plugins.name: watch
plugins.title: Watch
plugins.description: Watch a video by URL or local path: ffmpeg frame sampling plus a timestamped transcript (captions, local Whisper, or a consent-gated cloud API)

plugins.name: whatsapp
plugins.title: WhatsApp
plugins.description: WhatsApp connector — send text messages and templates via the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API

plugins.name: x
plugins.title: X
plugins.description: X (Twitter) connector — mentions, timelines, search, threads, and posting via the official X API v2

plugins.name: youtube
plugins.title: YouTube
plugins.description: Search YouTube, inspect videos and channels, manage playlists, and read/post comments
